1

Joy Boy Agency

A managed entertainment department — one accountable unit, not a collection of freelancers.
This season 268 Staff-days delivered July–August 2026 at True Beach Resort, logged person by person in a daily register
Repertoire depth 115 Show slots in one Marsa Alam season Casa Blue Beach Resort, May–June — a two-week guest never saw the same night twice
What we run
  • The full evening programme — dance, oriental, fire, live singers, DJ nights and headline theme nights on a rotating repertoire
  • The daytime line — aqua gym, sports, pool and beach parties, foam party
  • A children's line — staffed daily sessions, nightly Mini Disco, a weekly kids event with costumed characters
  • Live music — instrumentalists and singers on rotation across venues
How we run it
  • A weekly action plan — every event carries its setup, costume-check and soundcheck deadlines and a named owner of the running order
  • A daily attendance register — presence, day-off, vacation and absence per person, totalled monthly
  • A published guest programme — on a board and by QR code
  • Monthly reporting — punctuality, sessions delivered, review mentions

Price list

The team as a fixed monthly line; every show and event priced per performance.
The team A permanent team of 9, resident at the hotel

Not visiting acts. The kids club entertainer and the DJ are dedicated roles, not shared duties.

RoleHeadcountMonthly eachMonthly
Team LeaderRuns the programme, the running order and the weekly action plan 1 € 800 —
DJResident — daytime energy, mini disco, evening sets 1 € 550 —
Kids club entertainerDedicated to the children's line, every day 1 € 550 —
Fitness / sport entertainersAqua gym, sports, games, hosting — per entertainer 6 € 550 —
Team of 9 — monthly total 9 —
Why a resident team 7/7 Days a week the programme runs Guests remember the same faces all week — and the same faces are what turn a good holiday into a named five-star review. Roster continuity is a scheduling decision, and we schedule for it deliberately.
Kids, answered 1 Dedicated kids club entertainer — in the team, not borrowed from it The children's line never loses its person to another duty. Mini Disco runs nightly; the weekly character event comes from the events list.
